nodes.description: mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public requests storing minted token ids per request id
mapping(address => uint256[]) public userRequests mapping user to their request ids
mapping(uint256 => bool) public claimedTokenId tracking already rewarded token ids
address public sncAddress, the SNC NFT contract used for balance and minting
uint256 public maxTokenId upper bound of eligible original token ids
uint256 public requestsReceived counter of processed claim requests
uint256 public tokenRewardAmount number of tokens minted per eligible token, default 3
public whenNotPaused nonReentrant claim(): reads NFT balance, loops over user tokens and mints rewards via ISNC
external view getTokenIdsOnBalance(address): returns eligible unclaimed token ids of an account
external view getUserRequestsLength(address): returns number of requests of an account
external view getTokenIds(address,uint256): returns token ids minted for a given request
external whenPaused onlyOwner withdrawToken(address,address): withdraws full token balance of contract
public whenPaused onlyOwner withdrawSomeToken(address,address,uint256): withdraws part of a token balance
external whenPaused onlyOwner withdraw(): withdraws entire native balance to the caller
external onlyOwner withdrawSome(address,uint256): withdraws a specified native amount to a recipient
external onlyOwner pause(): pauses the contract via Pausable._pause
external onlyOwner unpause(): unpauses the contract via Pausable._unpause
external onlyOwner updateSncAddress(address): changes the SNC contract address
external onlyOwner updateTokenRewardAmount(uint256): changes the reward amount per token
external onlyOwner updateMaxTokenId(uint256): changes the maximum eligible token id
msg.sender accessed through _msgSender(), attacker controllable caller identity
external call ISNC(sncAddress).mint(account, tokenMinted) executed inside claim loop after state reads
IERC20(_token).safeTransfer(_recipient,_value) token transfer performing an external low level call
payable(_recipient).call{value:_value}('') native transfer inside _deliverFunds
internal virtual _withdraw(address,uint256): validates recipient and balance then delivers native funds
internal _deliverFunds(address,uint256,string): performs the native low level value call and requires success
internal virtual _withdrawToken(address,address,uint256): validates and safe-transfers ERC20 tokens
internal _transferOwnership(address): updates owner state and emits OwnershipTransferred
constructor parameter _sncAddress assigned to sncAddress state variable
constructor parameter _maxTokenId assigned to maxTokenId state variable
_account parameter of the view getters (getTokenIdsOnBalance/getUserRequestsLength/getTokenIds)
_requestIndex parameter of getTokenIds selecting a user request
_token parameter identifying the ERC20 withdrawn in withdrawToken/withdrawSomeToken/_withdrawToken
_recipient parameter receiving withdrawn assets
_amount parameter of withdrawSomeToken/withdrawSome/_withdraw controlling transfer size
local account = _msgSender() inside claim
local balance = ISNC(sncAddress).balanceOf(account) inside claim/getTokenIdsOnBalance
local requestId = requestsReceived used as key for requests mapping in claim
local tokenId from tokenOfOwnerByIndex inside claim/getTokenIdsOnBalance
local totalSupply = ISNC(sncAddress).totalSupply() read per eligible token in claim
local tokenMinted = totalSupply + j passed to the mint external call
loop index i over the NFT balance in claim and view functions
loop index j over tokenRewardAmount and array fill index in view functions

edges.reason: msg.sender via _msgSender() becomes the caller-controlled account in claim
claim performs an external mint call to the ISNC contract inside its loop, allowing a malicious sncAddress to reenter
claim writes minted token ids into requests[requestId]
claim pushes the new request id into userRequests[account]
claim sets claimedTokenId[tokenId] = true
claim increments requestsReceived after the loops
claim reads tokenRewardAmount as the inner mint loop bound
claim compares tokenId <= maxTokenId to filter eligible tokens
claim reads sncAddress to build and call the ISNC contract
updateSncAddress overwrites the sncAddress state variable
updateTokenRewardAmount overwrites tokenRewardAmount
updateMaxTokenId overwrites maxTokenId
withdraw delegates the native payout to internal _withdraw
withdrawSome delegates the native payout to internal _withdraw
_withdraw calls _deliverFunds to send native currency
_deliverFunds executes the low level value call transferring control to the recipient before external state settles
withdrawToken delegates the token payout to internal _withdrawToken
withdrawSomeToken delegates the token payout to internal _withdrawToken
_withdrawToken performs an ERC20 safeTransfer which can invoke recipient/token code before state is settled
getTokenIdsOnBalance reads sncAddress to query the NFT contract
getTokenIdsOnBalance filters using claimedTokenId
getTokenIdsOnBalance compares tokenId <= maxTokenId
getUserRequestsLength reads userRequests[_account].length
getTokenIds resolves the requestId from userRequests[_account][_requestIndex]
getTokenIds returns requests[requestId]
pause is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
unpause is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
updateSncAddress is gated by onlyOwner against _msgSender()
updateTokenRewardAmount is gated by onlyOwner against _msgSender()
updateMaxTokenId is gated by onlyOwner against _msgSender()
withdrawToken is gated by onlyOwner and whenPaused against _msgSender()
withdrawSomeToken is gated by onlyOwner and whenPaused against _msgSender()
withdraw is gated by onlyOwner and forwards _msgSender() to _withdraw
withdrawSome is gated by onlyOwner against _msgSender()
constructor argument _sncAddress initializes sncAddress
constructor argument _maxTokenId initializes maxTokenId
_account parameter drives the balance lookup in getTokenIdsOnBalance
_requestIndex parameter indexes userRequests to find the request id
_recipient parameter is forwarded to _withdrawToken as transfer destination
_amount parameter bounds the token transfer in withdrawSomeToken
local account variable is the loop subject in claim
local balance bounds the claim loop iterations
local requestId keys userRequests and requests writes in claim
local tokenId drives the eligibility check in claim
local totalSupply is read fresh on every eligible token in claim
local tokenMinted is the id passed to the mint external call
loop index i controls iteration over the NFT balance in claim
loop index j controls the reward mint loop in claim
withdraw passes _msgSender() as the recipient into _withdraw which performs the native call
_token parameter selects the IERC20 contract safe-transferred in _withdrawToken
safeTransfer internally performs a low level call on the possibly attacker-supplied token contract

normalization_plan.reason: _account is only used as the balance owner lookup key in the view getters
_token is only used to identify the ERC20 to withdraw in the withdraw family
_recipient is only used as the withdrawal destination inside the withdraw family
_amount only bounds the amount transferred by the partial withdraw functions
account is a temporary alias of _msgSender() scoped to claim
balance is a transient snapshot of the NFT balance used to bound claim's loop
requestId is a temporary copy of requestsReceived inside claim
tokenId is a loop-scoped value read from the NFT contract inside claim
totalSupply is a per-iteration temporary read of the NFT total supply
tokenMinted is computed only to be supplied to the mint external call
i is only the index controlling claim's iteration over the caller's NFTs
j is only the index controlling claim's reward minting loop
